picks.what: The Old Tower (St Mary’s Steeple), tinted lithograph (British Museum)
picks.who: Lowes Cato Dickinson after Clarkson Stanfield
picks.why: the city’s medieval steeple above old houses; only candidate of Dundee, Scotland; margins and imprint trimmed

gaps: P0, P1, P2, P3, P5, P6: nothing (no general view at all)
notes: #2–#5 are Dundee Canal and the Dundee Textile Mill in Passaic, New Jersey, not Dundee. #1 is a landmark scene, not a general view; it shows a cleared building site around the steeple.
